children: Stephens & Co. reiterated their Equal-Weight rating on Oscar Health's stock with a price target of $34.00.
The price target implies an upside of 5.1% from the Sep 16 close of $32.34.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Oscar Health has forecasted significant revenue growth, with expectations of a 20% CAGR from 2026 to 2029, driven by expansion in existing markets and new product offerings. This stable growth outlook supports the Equal-Weight rating as it suggests a balanced risk-reward scenario for investors.

: Despite facing adverse market conditions following the expiration of ACA enhanced subsidies, Oscar Health has demonstrated resilience by lowering its Medical Loss Ratio (MLR) expectations and increasing its Earnings from Operations guidance. This ability to adapt operational metrics positively contributes to maintaining an Equal-Weight stance on the stock.
